name: Pixel Display Bluetooth Speaker
description: A compact desktop speaker with a pixel-style display and wireless audio playback. Ideal for a bedside table or workspace; connect your phone over Bluetooth to enjoy music and podcasts.

name: GPS Fitness Smartwatch
description: Track outdoor workouts, daily steps and activity trends from a wrist-mounted display. Built-in GPS helps record your route without keeping your phone in hand.

name: Everyday Activity Tracker
description: A lightweight activity tracker for step counting, workout reminders and everyday movement. A practical first fitness wearable for checking progress during walks and runs.

name: Adventure Action Camera
description: Capture rides, hikes and weekend adventures with a compact action camera. Its small body is easy to mount or pack; use a suitable protective housing around water.

name: Compact Wireless Home Speaker
description: Bring music and spoken audio to a small room with this compact wireless speaker. Pair it with a compatible phone or tablet and keep playback controls close at hand.

name: Everyday Smartwatch with Notifications
description: Check phone notifications and daily activity at a glance. This everyday smartwatch combines a clear display with simple fitness tracking for workdays and weekends.

name: Foldable Wireless Over-Ear Headphones
description: Listen to music, join calls and pack light with foldable wireless headphones. Cushioned ear cups and an integrated microphone make them a convenient everyday audio companion.

name: 13.5-inch Everyday Laptop
description: A portable 13.5-inch laptop for documents, web browsing and video meetings. Its compact format suits study sessions and everyday office work without taking over your desk.

name: Robot Vacuum and Mop
description: Take the routine out of floor cleaning with a robot vacuum and mop. Designed for regular maintenance of suitable hard floors; clear cables and loose objects before each cleaning run.

name: Everyday Smartphone 6 GB / 128 GB
description: A versatile smartphone with 6 GB of memory and 128 GB of storage for daily apps, photos and messages. A balanced choice for staying connected, watching videos and navigating on the go.

name: Indoor Wi-Fi Security Camera
description: Keep an eye on an indoor room with a Wi-Fi security camera. Position it on a stable surface, connect it to your home network and use the companion setup to check the camera view.

name: Compact Hot-Melt Glue Gun
description: A compact hot-melt glue gun for craft projects and small repairs. Feed a compatible glue stick, allow the tool to heat up and apply carefully; the nozzle and molten adhesive become hot.

name: Android TV Box 2 GB / 16 GB
description: Add app-based streaming to an HDMI television with an Android TV box. Includes 2 GB of memory and 16 GB of storage; a network connection and separate subscriptions may be required for streaming services.

name: Wireless Game Controller
description: A wireless game controller with dual analogue sticks and familiar face buttons. Designed for comfortable play sessions; check your console or computer compatibility before ordering.

name: 12 V Cordless Drill Driver
description: Handle household drilling and fastening tasks with a compact 12 V cordless drill driver. Use the appropriate drill bit and torque setting for each job, and wear eye protection while working.

name: Portable Outdoor Bluetooth Speaker
description: A portable Bluetooth speaker for music in the garden, on a picnic or around the home. Pair it with your phone for wireless playback and keep it away from immersion in water.

name: HDMI TV Streaming Stick
description: Turn an available HDMI input into a compact streaming setup. Connect the stick to your television and power supply, then join your Wi-Fi network; streaming subscriptions are purchased separately.

name: 13-inch LCD Writing Tablet
description: Sketch, practise handwriting and jot down quick reminders on a reusable LCD writing tablet. Use the included stylus and erase the display when finished; this is a writing pad, not an app-running tablet.

name: Fabric-Finish Bluetooth Speaker
description: A fabric-finish wireless speaker for everyday music and podcasts. Its compact shape fits neatly on a shelf or desk and pairs with compatible Bluetooth devices.

name: Performance Smartphone 8 GB / 256 GB
description: Keep more photos, videos and apps with 256 GB of storage and 8 GB of memory. This smartphone is suited to multitasking, everyday photography and entertainment on the move.

name: True Wireless Earbuds with Charging Case
description: Enjoy cable-free listening with true wireless earbuds and a compact charging case. Pair with a Bluetooth phone for music and calls, then store the earbuds in their case between uses.

name: Advanced Robot Vacuum with Mopping
description: An advanced robot vacuum with mopping for routine home floor care. Use scheduled cleaning to maintain suitable floors between deeper cleans, and keep the dust compartment and cleaning pads maintained.

name: Powered Home Theatre Subwoofer
description: Add low-frequency depth to a compatible home theatre system with a powered subwoofer. Connect it to a suitable receiver output and adjust placement and level to suit your room.

name: Compact Digital Music Player
description: Carry your offline music library without using your phone battery. This compact digital music player offers straightforward playback controls and a wired headphone connection.

name: Sport Smartwatch with Activity Tracking
description: Follow your daily movement and workout sessions on a clear wrist display. A sport-focused smartwatch for checking activity progress and staying aware of phone notifications throughout the day.
